response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong craftsmanship mindset, open-source leadership, and teaching/mentoring track record, but he does not meet the core hard requirements of this role. The position demands 8 years of C++ programming; his resume shows roughly 6 months of C/C++ work at National Instruments (2014–2015) plus a university thesis project, with the bulk of his career in TypeScript/Node.js, D, and web/full-stack work. Large-scale distributed systems exposure exists (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby, high-throughput microservices in D) but is limited to about two years and is not cloud-compute-platform infrastructure. He also lacks a formal technical leadership role owning platform strategy. He could be a strong fit for a senior full-stack or developer-tooling role, but not for a C++-centric cloud compute platform tech lead.
strengths: Broad 15+ year engineering career spanning web, embedded, mobile, and high-throughput backend systems
Real low-latency, high-volume experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Sociomantic) plus DevOps/CI/Kubernetes exposure
Demonstrated mentoring and community leadership: workshops, courses, conference talks, and founding an open-source platform
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ against an 8-year minimum requirement
No formal technical leadership role or ownership of platform-level technical strategy
Limited production cloud architecture depth; infrastructure experience is not at cloud-compute-platform scale

key_factors.factor: Lack of formal technical leadership role
